highlights: Waller said a September rate hike remains possible if inflation does not ease
He emphasized that inflation dynamics, not just headline numbers, drive his policy stance
He is open to maintaining the current rate range pending supportive data

gas_crisis_ceramics_industry.headline: Bangladesh Ceramics Industry Crippled by Gas Shortages, Production Falls to 35%
gas_crisis_ceramics_industry.summary: Severe gas shortages have forced over 30 ceramics factories to operate at less than half capacity, slashing output to about 35% and threatening exports.
highlights: Gas pressure has dropped from the required 15 PSI to as low as 3–4 PSI, with occasional zero pressure.
Major producers such as RAK Ceramics and Great Wall have shut units, leaving many workers on leave.

knit_fabric_import_ban.institution: Bangladesh Garment Manufacturers and Exporters Association (BGMEA)
knit_fabric_import_ban.headline: Bangladesh Halts Knit Fabric Imports, Exporters Warn Export Decline
knit_fabric_import_ban.summary: The government’s new Import Policy Order bans most knit fabric imports, sparking fears that reduced raw material access could curb Bangladesh’s $39 billion apparel exports.
highlights: BGMEA and BKMEA have petitioned the commerce minister to withdraw the ban
The policy permits only specialised fabrics like man‑made fibre and technical textiles with exporter recommendation and

eu_trade_ties_discussion.headline: Bangladesh Seeks Deeper EU Trade Ties Amid Non‑Tariff Barrier Talks
eu_trade_ties_discussion.summary: Bangladesh and EU ministers met in Dhaka to negotiate removal of remaining non‑tariff barriers, preserve EU market access after LDC graduation, and consider full foreign ownership in logistics.
highlights: EU identified 52 non‑tariff barriers; Bangladesh has addressed 40
Proposal to allow 100% foreign ownership in the logistics sector
Government aims to digitise customs with a National Single Window to cut clearance delays

bond_crisis_centralbanks.headline: Central Banks Intervene as Bond Market Crisis Looms, Scope Ratings Warns
bond_crisis_centralbanks.summary: Scope Ratings' Eiko Sievert says a bond market crisis is confirmed when central banks can no longer avoid stepping in to stabilize turmoil.
highlights: Scope Ratings flags central bank intervention as the definitive signal of a bond crisis.
Analyst Eiko Sievert, former FCA and ECB official, emphasizes the loss of policy autonomy as a red flag.

fed_governors_blackout.headline: Fed Governors Meet Bankers During Blackout Periods
fed_governors_blackout.summary: Two Federal Reserve governors attended private banking events during mandated blackout periods, raising questions about compliance with meeting restrictions ahead of the June FOMC decision.
highlights: Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman met with the head of the Massachusetts Bankers Association before the June 16‑17 FOMC
The meetings occurred despite blackout rules that limit interactions with financial firms

ai_stock_bullish.headline: Traders Turn to Bullish Chinese Stock Derivatives as AI Alternative
ai_stock_bullish.summary: Investors are shifting from crowded AI bets in Korea and Japan to bullish Chinese equity derivatives, targeting CSI mid‑ and small‑cap indexes.
highlights: Barclays Plc and UBS Group AG report rising client demand for bullish options on CSI indexes
Derivatives focus on mid‑ and small‑cap Chinese stocks as an alternative to AI‑heavy markets

governor_appointment_upheld.headline: High Court rejects challenge to Mostaqur Rahman's appointment as Bangladesh Bank governor
governor_appointment_upheld.summary: The High Court dismissed a writ contesting the removal of Ahsan H Mansur and the appointment of Md Mostaqur Rahman as Bangladesh Bank governor, upholding the government's decision.
highlights: The petition argued the removal violated the Bangladesh Bank Order, 1972.
The bench hearing the case comprised Justices Khizir Ahmed Choudhury and AF Saiful Karim.

eu_non_tariff_barriers_cleared.headline: Bangladesh Clears 48 EU Non‑Tariff Barriers, 13 Remain
eu_non_tariff_barriers_cleared.summary: Bangladesh has resolved 48 of 61 EU‑identified non‑tariff barriers, while coordinated efforts continue to address the remaining 13 issues.
highlights: Licence renewal hurdles for 100% foreign‑owned logistics firms were lifted
Import sample allowance doubled from $10,000 to $20,000
Customs valuation now uses smart‑card scanning for export traceability

dsex_falls_103_points.headline: DSEX plunges 103 points as heavy selling pressure hits market
dsex_falls_103_points.summary: The DSE benchmark DSEX fell 103 points, or 1.83%, to 5,558 amid sharply negative breadth and a 24% drop in daily turnover.
highlights: DSEX down 103 points (1.83%) to close at 5,558
DS30 slipped 24 points to 2,116
Turnover fell 24% to Tk545 crore as 348 stocks declined

private_placements_38_7bn.headline: China's AgBank and ICBC Target $38.7 Billion in Private Placements
private_placements_38_7bn.summary: Agricultural Bank of China aims to raise 160 billion yuan and ICBC 100 billion yuan via A‑share placements, with the finance ministry subscribing to most of the issue.
highlights: The Ministry of Finance will subscribe for 130 billion yuan of AgBank’s placement.
It will also subscribe for 70 billion yuan of ICBC’s placement.

spring_property_season_down.headline: Australian Spring Property Auctions Down 31% From 2025
spring_property_season_down.summary: Australian spring auctions saw nearly 1,500 homes listed, a 31% drop from last year, while clearance rates remained broadly steady despite recent tax changes.
highlights: Almost 1,500 homes were auctioned, 31% fewer than in 2025
Auction clearance rates stayed roughly unchanged
The slowdown follows May property‑tax reforms

oil_output_policy_october.headline: OPEC+ Holds October Oil Output Policy Steady Amid Iran Conflict
oil_output_policy_october.summary: OPEC+ ministers kept October quotas unchanged as the Iran war disrupts shipments through the Strait of Hormuz, limiting the group’s influence on market prices.
highlights: Seven core members—Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Algeria, Kazakhstan and Oman—met on 6 September.
OPEC+ completed a phased rollback of a 1.65 million‑barrel‑per‑day cut for September.
Production cuts remain in place for most members until the end of 2026.

specialised_asset_recovery_agency.headline: Bangladesh Mulls Specialized Agency to Recover Smuggled Assets
specialised_asset_recovery_agency.summary: Finance Minister Amir Khosru announced a plan to create a dedicated authority aimed at retrieving billions of taka laundered abroad and preventing future losses.
highlights: A 12‑member task force led by the Bangladesh Bank governor identified 11 priority money‑laundering cases
Joint Investigation Teams have frozen roughly Tk 76,983.93 crore in assets domestically and overseas

fertiliser_supply_blockade.headline: Bangladeshi Farmers Protest Fertiliser Shortage on Lalmonirhat‑Burimari Highway
fertiliser_supply_blockade.summary: Farmers halted traffic on the Lalmonirhat‑Burimari road, demanding sufficient fertiliser supplies and an end to trade syndicates, before dispersing after local officials promised investigation.
highlights: Blockade lasted about 30 minutes, causing long vehicle queues
Protest took place in front of a Bangladesh Agriculture and Fertilizer Association warehouse in Mahendranagar
Deputy Commissioner Md Rashedul Hoque Prodhan denied any fertiliser shortage in the district

turkey_cuts_2027_gdp_growth_forecast_to_.headline: Turkey Lowers 2027 GDP Growth Forecast to 4.2% Amid Election Uncertainty
turkey_cuts_2027_gdp_growth_forecast_to_.summary: Turkey's Medium‑Term Program now projects 2027 GDP growth at 4.2%, revising the 2026 outlook to 3.3% as political and regional risks rise.
highlights: Forecast for 2027 cut from 4.3% to 4.2%
2026 GDP growth revised down to 3.3% from 3.8%
Revision reflects fallout from the Iran war and upcoming elections

probe_of_uber_s_exit_from_nigeria.headline: Nigeria Antitrust Agency Probes Uber’s Sudden Exit
probe_of_uber_s_exit_from_nigeria.summary: Nigeria’s Federal Competition & Consumer Protection Commission is investigating Uber’s abrupt market withdrawal after the ride‑hailing firm ceased operations without notifying customers.
highlights: Uber halted services in Nigeria last week without prior notice
FCCPC CEO Tunji Bello said the probe will examine unfulfilled customer obligations
The investigation focuses on compliance with competition and consumer‑protection laws

russia_ukraine_exchange_strikes_as_us_en.headline: US Envoys Kushner and Witkoff Head to Kyiv Amid Russia‑Ukraine Strikes
russia_ukraine_exchange_strikes_as_us_en.summary: US officials Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff travel to Kyiv after talks with President Vladimir Putin, as Russia and Ukraine continue nightly missile exchanges.
highlights: Kushner and Witkoff met with President Vladimir Putin in Moscow before heading to Kyiv
A fire broke out at an unidentified facility in Russia’s Ryazan region
Russia and Ukraine exchanged overnight missile strikes throughout the region

agricultural_loan_waiver.headline: Bangladesh Waives Up to Tk10,000 Agricultural Loans for 14.34 Lakh Farmers
agricultural_loan_waiver.summary: Finance Minister Amir Khosru Mahmud Chowdhury announced that 14.34 lakh farmers received loan waivers of up to Tk10,000, with the government disbursing Tk1,352.74 crore to banks.
highlights: The waiver covers interest and principal up to Tk10,000 per farmer
Beneficiaries span all upazilas nationwide
The programme has cost the treasury Tk1,352.74 crore

bad_loan_accumulation.headline: Six State‑Owned Banks Accumulate Tk1.47 Lakh Crore Bad Loans
bad_loan_accumulation.summary: Six state‑owned banks recorded Tk1.47 lakh crore in non‑performing loans by June end, with Janata Bank alone holding over half the total.
highlights: Janata Bank leads with Tk75,396 crore in NPLs
Sector NPL ratio rose to 32.78% of total loans
Government paid Tk1,352.74 crore to settle waived farmer loans

domestic_gas_production_policy.headline: Bangladesh Seeks to Cut Imported Gas, Boost Domestic Production
domestic_gas_production_policy.summary: The government aims to lessen reliance on imported gas by increasing local extraction, seeking a permanent solution to the nation’s ongoing energy shortages.
highlights: Press Secretary Abu Abdullah M Saleh announced the policy at the ERF Language Club inauguration.
Shortages of gas, electricity and fuel oil are interconnected and worsened by supply disruptions in war‑affected exporting

iran_attacks_oil_tankers_sep_2026.headline: Iran Targets Oil Tankers After US Strikes in Hormuz
iran_attacks_oil_tankers_sep_2026.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guard Navy announced attacks on three oil tankers and several US-linked vessels after American strikes on Iranian tankers over the weekend.
highlights: The IRGC Navy used an unauthorized route through the Strait of Hormuz for the attacks
Iran also claimed to have struck a US naval drone and an unmanned surface vessel

salvini_proposes_bank_tax_sep_2026.headline: Italy Plans to Tax Bank Profits Like Spain, Says Salvini
salvini_proposes_bank_tax_sep_2026.summary: Vice Premier Matteo Salvini announced Italy will propose a tax on banks' profits, interest income and fees, mirroring Spain's recent policy.
highlights: Salvini praised Spain's bank tax as "intelligent" despite political differences
He pledged to include a similar tax measure in Italy's upcoming budget
The statement was made at the Ambrosetti Forum in Cernobbio

trump_comments_on_cad_usd_imbalance_sep_.headline: Trump Calls Canada‑US Dollar Imbalance Unacceptable
trump_comments_on_cad_usd_imbalance_sep_.summary: President Donald Trump warned on Truth Social that the current disparity between the Canadian dollar and the U.S. dollar cannot continue, urging corrective action.
highlights: Trump labeled the CAD‑USD exchange gap as “unacceptable”.
The comment was posted on his Truth Social platform.

dse_panic_sell_off_wipes_out_tk6_781_cr_.headline: Panic Selling Cripples Dhaka Stock Exchange, DSEX Drops 103 Points
dse_panic_sell_off_wipes_out_tk6_781_cr_.summary: Intense panic selling amid the energy crisis and alleged order interference caused DSE market capitalisation to fall Tk6,781 crore and the DSEX index to plunge 103 points.
highlights: 89% of stocks declined as market capitalisation shrank by Tk6,781 crore
Investors blame the nationwide gas and electricity crisis and alleged exchange interference
DSEX fell over 103 points, its first single‑day drop of that magnitude since June

new_auto_loan_directives_up_to_tk80_lakh.headline: Bangladesh Bank's New Loan Limits Spur Hybrid and EV Demand
new_auto_loan_directives_up_to_tk80_lakh.summary: Banks can now lend up to Tk80 lakh for hybrid and electric cars, prompting a sharp rise in auto‑loan applications and shifting buyer preferences.
highlights: City Bank’s auto‑loan applications jumped 30% in two months, reaching about 600 per month.
Mutual Trust Bank saw an 84% increase in loan files, while BRAC Bank’s disbursements more than doubled year‑on‑year.
Hybrid vehicles now dominate loan applications, outpacing conventional cars.

btrc_urges_google_to_deploy_ai_tools_to_.headline: BTRC Presses Google to Deploy AI for Removing Gambling Content in Bangladesh
btrc_urges_google_to_deploy_ai_tools_to_.summary: The Bangladesh Telecommunication Regulatory Commission urged Google to implement AI-driven tools that instantly detect and delete betting and gambling material from its platforms.
highlights: BTRC also requested Google to set up a local payment system and consider opening a Bangladesh office
Google’s South Asia Policy Head Kyle Gardner said the company will review AI cooperation but noted current constraints on

seriescfunding100m.headline: Google-backed Indian space startup Pixxel raises $100 million in Series C
seriescfunding100m.summary: Pixxel secured $100 million in a Series C round led by Temasek and Seraphim, bringing total funding to $195 million.
highlights: Series C round led by Temasek and Seraphim
Total funding now $195 million, the largest space‑tech raise in India

switzerland_trade_talks.headline: Swiss Ambassador Meets Bangladeshi Minister to Boost Trade and Skills Development
switzerland_trade_talks.summary: Switzerland’s ambassador Reto Renggli met State Minister Humaiun Kobir to explore increased Swiss investment, expand vocational training, and deepen bilateral ties.
highlights: Both sides identified economic partnership as a key pillar of relations
Switzerland supports the voluntary, safe repatriation of Rohingya refugees to Myanmar
Bangladesh’s new embassy in Bern will be operationalised to enhance cooperation

potato_export_drop_49.headline: Bangladesh Potato Exports Halve as Middle East War Spurs Shipping Costs
potato_export_drop_49.summary: Sea‑borne potato shipments fell 49% in FY26, cutting export earnings by 37.8% as container freight rates surged nearly fourfold amid Middle East conflict.
highlights: Malaysia remained the top destination, receiving $3.68 million of potatoes
Exporters cite inadequate cold‑chain storage as a key hurdle

spectrum_management_meeting.headline: Bangladesh Hosts APT Meeting Amid Growing Spectrum Pressure in Asia‑Pacific
spectrum_management_meeting.summary: Bangladesh's hosting of the APT Wireless Group meeting highlights regional challenges of limited spectrum as 5G, 6G and satellite services expand demand.
highlights: Nearly 400 telecom experts gathered in Dhaka for the five‑day AWG‑37 summit.
Bangladesh has about 190 million mobile connections and 110 million 4G subscribers as of July 2026.
The agenda includes spectrum sharing, AI in 6G, and low‑Earth‑orbit satellite communications.

hormuz_traffic_dip_2026.headline: Hormuz traffic falls to ten ships daily after US and Iranian tanker strikes
hormuz_traffic_dip_2026.summary: Average daily transits through the Strait of Hormuz dropped to ten vessels, the lowest level since May, following recent US and Iranian attacks on tankers.
highlights: Transit volume fell from over 15 ships on Friday to ten on Sunday
Only two vessels passed on Saturday, six on Sunday, mainly via the Iranian route

inflation_august_2026.headline: Bangladesh inflation eases to 8.26% in August, food prices slow while non‑food rises
inflation_august_2026.summary: In August 2026, Bangladesh's overall inflation fell to 8.26%, driven by a dip in food inflation to 7.02% despite a rise in non‑food inflation.
highlights: Food inflation dropped to 7.02% from 7.16% in July.
Non‑food inflation rose to 9.32% in August, up from 9.28% in July.

chattogram_port_projects.headline: Three Projects to Modernise Chattogram Port, No Magnama Deep‑Sea Port Planned
chattogram_port_projects.summary: Bangladesh will upgrade Chattogram Port with Laldia Terminal, a new mooring terminal and Bay Terminal, while dismissing any Magnama deep‑sea port scheme.
highlights: Laldia Container Terminal construction started on 30 August on 49.15 acres, slated to operate by 2030 under APM Terminals.
Bay Terminal will handle vessels with 12 m draft and 5,000‑6,000 TEU ships via a PPP model.
Matarbari deep‑sea port, not Magnama, will accommodate 16 m draft and up to 8,200 TEU, adding about 1 million TEUs to capacity.

company_act_modernisation.headline: Bangladesh to Modernise Companies Act with Business Community Input
company_act_modernisation.summary: Commerce Minister Khandakar Abdul Muqtadir announced a draft amendment to the 1994 Companies Act, seeking stakeholder feedback to align the law with modern business needs.
highlights: Draft amendment open for 30‑60 days for businesses to submit comments
BSEC proposes allowing listed companies to buy back shares and modernising annual report terminology
Government aims to align law with international standards to support LDC graduation

economic_issue_threat.headline: Iran Vows Economic War Headquarters Push Amid Threat of Painful Retaliation
economic_issue_threat.summary: Iran announced the creation of an Economic War Headquarters to counter U.S. sanctions while warning that any further attacks will trigger a faster, heavier and more painful response.
highlights: Iran established an Economic War Headquarters to address war‑related economic problems
U.S. strikes hit three Iranian vessels after IRGC launched ballistic missiles at U.S. Navy ships
The preliminary cease‑fire accord reached in June has unraveled, leaving the conflict at a stalemate

energy_taskforce_opposition.headline: Opposition Leader Demands Energy Taskforce as Bangladesh Targets Crisis End by 2030
energy_taskforce_opposition.summary: Shafiqur Rahman urged a joint political‑technical taskforce to address power shortages, meter fees and demand charges while the government pledges to resolve the crisis by 2030.
highlights: Government plans to drill 150 new gas wells and launch an offshore oil‑gas bidding round.
Tk29,000 crore required to abolish meter rental fees and shift consumers to smart prepaid meters by 2030.
Target to generate 5,000 MW of electricity from solar power.

ipo_drought_6months.headline: Bangladesh IPO Drought Persists Six Months into New Government
ipo_drought_6months.summary: Six months after the new government took office, the Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission has yet to approve any new IPOs, extending the market’s capital‑raising drought.
highlights: No company has submitted an IPO application since the BSEC commission took charge in June.
Around Tk1,000 crore of proposed offerings have been withdrawn since March 2024, reducing primary market fundraising.

fsru_investment_interest.headline: US firms eye more FSRU projects in Bangladesh, says ambassador
fsru_investment_interest.summary: US Ambassador Brent Christensen told Commerce Minister Khandakar Abdul Muktadir that American companies are keen to build additional floating storage and regasification units in Bangladesh.
highlights: US firms express strong interest in constructing additional FSRUs in Bangladesh
Bangladesh government gave in‑principle approval to China National Energy Engineering for the third FSRU under a
New policy removes requirement for foreign firms to appoint local agents, increasing procurement transparency

pboc_gold_purchase_2026_09_07.headline: China Central Bank Boosts Gold Reserves Amid Surge in Bullion Prices
pboc_gold_purchase_2026_09_07.summary: In August, the People’s Bank of China added its largest gold stockpile since 2023, even as global bullion prices jumped to multi‑year highs.
highlights: Gold purchases accelerated in August, marking the biggest monthly increase since 2023.
Bullion prices rose sharply, reaching their highest level in over two years.

stocks_oil_inflation_risk_2026_09_07.headline: Asian stocks rise on strong US jobs data, oil climbs amid Gulf tensions
stocks_oil_inflation_risk_2026_09_07.summary: Asian equities rallied on a robust US jobs report that lowered expectations of rate hikes, while oil prices edged higher after US‑Iran maritime clashes.
highlights: Nikkei led gains across Asian markets as shares bounced.
Oil prices rose modestly after US forces and Iran attacked ships in the Gulf.
ECB is expected to raise rates despite market focus on policy guidance.

risk_appetite_bond_yields_2026_09_07.headline: Investors Embrace Risk as Global Bond Yields Keep Rising
risk_appetite_bond_yields_2026_09_07.summary: Despite climbing global bond yields, investors are shifting toward equities and credit markets, buoyed by rising corporate earnings and a stronger risk appetite.
highlights: Equities and high‑yield credit outperformed as earnings growth accelerated
Global sovereign bond yields rose across major markets, yet risk assets kept attracting capital

solar_manufacturing.headline: Walton and PRAN-RFL Launch Domestic Solar Inverter and Battery Production
solar_manufacturing.summary: Amid Bangladesh’s energy crisis, the conglomerates are building local solar inverter and lithium‑ion battery factories to cut imports and meet a 4,000 MW solar target.
highlights: PRAN‑RFL will start a $1 million inverter plant in Narsingdi, aiming for 1,000 units per month.
Walton has completed a lithium‑ion battery plant and will begin inverter production, reducing reliance on $15 million of annual

cross_border_trains.headline: Bangladesh, India to Resume Cross‑Border Passenger Trains by October
cross_border_trains.summary: Bangladesh and India aim to restart three major passenger train routes, including Maitree Express, by October 2026 after a two‑year suspension.
highlights: The annual railway meeting will be held in Dhaka to finalize service arrangements.
Bangladesh may propose a new Rajshahi‑Kolkata train and reroute Maitree Express via Padma Bridge.

foreign_flagged_ships.headline: Foreign‑Flagged Ships Dominate Chattogram Port Trade, Carry 89% of Imports
foreign_flagged_ships.summary: In the first half of 2026, foreign‑flagged vessels handled about 89% of Chattogram Port’s import cargo and 84% of its export cargo.
highlights: Foreign vessels moved 6,22,797 TEUs of imports, representing 89% of total cargo
Bangladesh plans to expand its own fleet to reduce foreign‑currency outflows and create jobs

entry_exams_mandatory_private_banks.headline: Bangladesh Bank Mandates Entry Exams and Certificate Verification for Private Banks
entry_exams_mandatory_private_banks.summary: Private banks must now require written and oral exams for entry‑level hires and verify all educational certificates within a year, tightening merit‑based recruitment.
highlights: Recruitment notices must appear on the bank’s website and in at least two national newspapers.
Higher‑position hires need a competitive process including an oral test and must follow the same verification rules.

withdrawal_duty_free_bonded_import_yarn.headline: Bangladesh Ends Duty‑Free Bonded Yarn Imports to Boost Local Spinning
withdrawal_duty_free_bonded_import_yarn.summary: The National Board of Revenue cancelled duty‑free bonded imports for 10‑30‑count cotton yarn, urging mills to rely on domestic production backed by 100% bank guarantees.
highlights: NBR Order No 51/2026/Customs/519 revoked bonded benefits for HS 5205‑5207 yarn categories.
Genuine exporters may still import yarn with a full bank guarantee.
BTMA expects idle mills to resume production, creating jobs and reducing banks’ non‑performing loans.

workers_incentive_bonus_record_handling.headline: Chattogram Port Workers Receive Tk16.65 crore Incentive Bonus
workers_incentive_bonus_record_handling.summary: The Chattogram Port Authority awarded a Tk16.65 crore incentive bonus, giving each of 6,750 workers Tk25,000 to sustain smooth operations and labour peace.
highlights: Bonus funded entirely by the Chattogram Port Container, Cargo Handling Workers and Employees Welfare Fund
Distribution ceremony held in CPA boardroom with senior officials handing cheques to berth, terminal and ship-handling operators
Incentive aims to maintain uninterrupted port activities amid rising container volumes

yen_7month_high_2026_09_08.headline: Yen climbs to seven‑month high on hawkish BOJ bets, dollar steadies ahead of CPI
yen_7month_high_2026_09_08.summary: The Japanese yen surged to its strongest level in seven months as markets priced in tighter policy from the Bank of Japan, while the U.S. dollar softened before the upcoming consumer price index release.
highlights: Yen reaches a seven‑month peak against the dollar
Traders price in potential BOJ rate hikes
Dollar eases ahead of the U.S. CPI data

gold_decline_fed_rate_hike_2026_09_07.headline: Gold Holds Decline Amid Fed Rate Hike Speculation
gold_decline_fed_rate_hike_2026_09_07.summary: Gold steadied around $4,430 per ounce after a 1% drop, as strong August payrolls revive expectations of a Federal Reserve rate increase next week.
highlights: Gold price hovered near $4,430/oz after a 1% decline
August US job growth surged while unemployment remained steady
Federal Reserve may raise rates at its Sept 15‑16 meeting

bangladesh_bank_appoints_administrator_f.headline: Bangladesh Bank appoints administrator to resolve Fareast Finance crisis
bangladesh_bank_appoints_administrator_f.summary: Bangladesh Bank named Director Md Sadequr Rahman and two associate administrators to manage the resolution of non‑viable NBFI Fareast Finance after its stock trading suspension.
highlights: Director Md Sadequr Rahman was appointed as administrator with Shadril Ahmed and Md Al‑Amin as associate administrators
Fareast Finance was declared non‑viable under the Bank Resolution Act, 2026
The Dhaka Stock Exchange and Chittagong Stock Exchange suspended trading of its shares

dream71_wins_undp_contract_to_develop_st.headline: Bangladesh’s Dream71 Secures UNDP Contract for Timor-Leste Digital Planning System
dream71_wins_undp_contract_to_develop_st.summary: Dream71 Bangladesh Ltd will build a web‑based Strategic Planning and Investment Management Information System for Timor‑Leste’s Ministry of Planning under UNDP’s Pro PALOP‑TL programme.
highlights: System will integrate monitoring of the Strategic Development Plan 2011‑2030, Medium‑Term Plan 2026‑2030, and SDG progress.
Platform features interactive dashboards, offline data entry, role‑based access and automated backup for low‑bandwidth
Project includes six‑month development plus a year of technical support, marking Bangladesh’s expanding ICT export footprint.

customers_withdraw_tk670cr_from_sammilit.headline: Sammilito Islamic Bank Processes Tk670 crore Withdrawals in Two Days
customers_withdraw_tk670cr_from_sammilit.summary: Customers withdrew Tk670 crore from Sammilito Islamic Bank over two days, while withdrawal applications totalled Tk2,345 crore, according to bank sources.
highlights: Around 14,000 customers completed withdrawals, far fewer than the 37,600 applicants
Bangladesh Bank injected Tk5,000 crore to support deposit repayments
The bank was formed by merging five predecessor banks

asia_stocks_yen.headline: Asia stocks waver as yen surges and Iran threatens retaliation
asia_stocks_yen.summary: Asian equity markets slipped modestly on Tuesday as the Japanese yen rallied sharply while Iran warned of possible retaliatory measures against Western sanctions.
highlights: The yen rose to its strongest level in months, pressuring export‑driven stocks.
Iran’s foreign ministry issued a statement warning of counter‑measures if sanctions intensify.

august_pmi_shows_resilience_despite_slow.headline: Bangladesh PMI dips below 50 as manufacturing contracts, agriculture holds steady
august_pmi_shows_resilience_despite_slow.summary: In August, Bangladesh's overall PMI slipped to 49.9, reflecting contraction in manufacturing and services while agriculture expanded for the twelfth month and construction rebounded.
highlights: Manufacturing PMI fell sharply to 47.4, the steepest decline recorded.
Agriculture PMI rose to 56.5, marking a 12th consecutive month of growth.
Construction PMI returned to expansion at 52.4 after previous contraction.

bepza_zone_2_export_debut_50k_machinery_.headline: Bepza Zone‑2 Launches Export with $50,000 Tobacco Machinery Shipment
bepza_zone_2_export_debut_50k_machinery_.summary: Bangladesh’s Bepza Economic Zone‑2 in Mirsharai shipped its first export, a $50,000 tobacco machinery order to Indonesia, signalling the zone’s operational start.
highlights: Export value totals $50,000, the zone’s inaugural overseas shipment.
Lee’s Tobacco Machinery Company Ltd is the first exporter, investing $3.72 million and employing 29 staff.
With this export, Bangladesh now has ten operational Bepza zones, including eight EPZs and two Economic Zones.

tbsnews.net/bangladesh/uae-has-no-inform.headline: UAE Government Says No Evidence Benazir Ahmed Has Left Country
tbsnews.net/bangladesh/uae-has-no-inform.summary: Bangladesh’s Foreign Affairs State Minister Humaiun Kobir told parliament that the UAE has no record of former IGP Benazir Ahmed departing, casting doubt on recent bail rumors.
highlights: Humaiun Kobir confirmed UAE officials are unaware of any departure by Benazir Ahmed.
The UAE handles extradition requests individually, and Bangladesh will maintain diplomatic pressure.

us_cotton_warehouse_launch.headline: Private US Cotton Warehouse Opens in Bangladesh, Cutting Lead Times
us_cotton_warehouse_launch.summary: The new privately run US cotton warehouse in Anwara, Chattogram will let textile mills source cotton locally, slashing 90‑day import lead times and lowering prices.
highlights: Import lead time drops from about 90 days to immediate local delivery.
Warehouse pricing aims to be roughly 10 cents per pound cheaper than current spot rates.
US cotton imports rose to $346 million in FY25, about 10% of Bangladesh’s total cotton imports.

gas_supply_suspension.headline: Gas Supply Suspended for Eight Hours in Dhaka Amid Expressway Project
gas_supply_suspension.summary: Titas Gas will cut service from 1 pm to 9 pm on 10 September in multiple Dhaka neighborhoods to allow pipeline relocation for the Dhaka Elevated Expressway.
highlights: Service interruption will affect residential and commercial customers in ten specified areas of Dhaka.
Customers in nearby zones may experience reduced gas pressure during the work.

tbsnews.net/world/malaysia-helicopter-cr.headline: Helicopter Crash Claims Five Lives in Sarawak, Malaysia
tbsnews.net/world/malaysia-helicopter-cr.summary: A BO-105 helicopter operated by Malaysia’s Flying Doctor Service crashed near Miri, killing a pilot, a doctor, a medical assistant and two nurses.
highlights: The crash occurred about 315 km southeast of Miri in remote Sarawak
